text: Rev. Jesse Jackson dies at 84. Public confirmation activates full historical record of his roles in civil rights leadership, presidential campaigns, and diplomatic service. His status shifts from active public actor to closed historical figure within U.S. political memory.

meta.note: Retrieval and exposure operate symbolically at memory layer; dominance between them is near-equal.

text: Netflix grants Warner Bros. Discovery a seven-day waiver permitting engagement with Paramount Skydance despite an existing merger agreement. Paramount maintains a hostile tender offer while Netflix retains matching rights. WBD board continues recommending the Netflix transaction as shareholders await a binding superior proposal.

meta.note: Authority divergence is contractual rather than operational; resolution vector reflects formal contest closure mechanism.

text: Amazon shares close up over 1%, ending a nine-session decline that erased roughly 18% of market value. The selloff followed guidance for $200 billion in capital expenditures, largely AI infrastructure. Peer megacap technology stocks remain under pressure as aggregate capex projections approach $700 billion.

meta.note: Inversion reflects price direction shift only; underlying capex posture remains unchanged.
